name: MERA
description: An open multimodal evaluation benchmark for Russian-language foundation models, featuring 21 evaluation tasks across 11 skill domains. Designed as a black-box test to prevent data leakage, it supports zero- and few-shot instruction evaluation and includes an open-source codebase and leaderboard.
reputation: A well-known Russian-language multimodal benchmark with an open leaderboard and codebase, used for evaluating foundation models in the Russian AI community.
notes: Focuses on Russian language models with a methodology to avoid data leakage; includes a submission system and leaderboard.
